description: Searches the account's pages by name, domain and/or page id. Filters are AND-combined; name and domain are case-insensitive substrings, and domain matches custom_domain or default_domain. Each result includes id, name, organization_id, custom_domain, default_domain and updated_at. With no filters it returns the most recently updated pages. Requires Webcake credentials.

domain.description: Case-insensitive substring of the page's domain (matches custom_domain OR default_domain).

name.description: Case-insensitive substring of the page name to match.

page_id.description: Exact page id — narrows to that single page (useful to confirm it exists/owned).

name: find_pages
